title: Dedicated Capacity QuickScan infographic, autoscale micro-interactions, and responsive screenshot suite
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Produce a lightweight, scannable set of visuals for the Dedicated onboarding flow aimed at helping engineers and platform owners make a capacity decision in under 90 seconds. Deliverables: a 1-panel QuickScan infographic that summarizes capacity tradeoffs (cost, latency, availability), two interactive micro-interaction prototypes for the Autoscale knob (conservative vs aggressive) and SLA toggle, and a responsive screenshot suite (desktop/tablet/mobile) for the docs release. Emphasize clarity of defaults, failure/fallback state visuals, and copy that maps directly to product knobs (min/max replicas, burst pool, SLA tiers). Include localized microcopy variants for EN/FR/DE. Primary success metrics: reduce first-run NPS friction score by 15% in the pilot group and decrease support tickets about capacity choice by 30% in the first 60 days.
acceptance_criteria: QuickScan infographic approved by PM and Eng lead
Two working interactive prototypes in Figma with annotated microcopy variants
Responsive screenshots exported at 1x/2x for desktop/tablet/mobile and uploaded to Drive
Localization strings handed off to i18n owner with screenshots for review
Design tokens used are audit-compatible with the design system and documented
